title: 応用化学専門実験・演習Ａ３
subtitle: Applied Chemistry Major Lab/Exercises A3
educationalGoal: You will learn the skills related to chemistry experimental operations, instrument handling, instrumental analysis, data analysis, and report preparation. You will also acquire the ability to evaluate the results from qualitative and quantitative experiments, and perform logical thinking. Through experiments and exercises, you will learn experimental theories and methods.
advice:
Conduct experiments and exercises in environmental chemistry. If understanding the experiments and exercises is difficult, gain the understanding before the next class through research, questions, or other methods.

Experimental guidance, safety training, examination
Basis of environmental chemistry experiments, BOD measurement, standardization of KMnO4 for measurement of COD, measurement of COD, determination of the composition of a metal complex
books:
Textbooks: Ouyou Kagaku Senmon Jikken/enshu AB (Kanazawa Institute of Technology Publishing)
Reference books: Unspecified
Reserved books: Jikken Deta wo Tadashiku Atsukau tameni (Kagaku Dojin Publishing), Jikken wo Anzen ni Okonau tameni (Kagaku Dojin Publishing), Zoku Jikken wo Anzen ni Okonau tameni (Kagaku Dojin Publishing)
requiredKnowledge: Fundamental knowledge about analytical chemistry, physical chemistry, organic chemistry, and environmental chemistry. If progress of the experiment is delayed, time will be extended until the experiment is completed, so keep some time free after the class on experiment days.

activityGoals.body: Handle instruments and equipment safely and explain the experimental procedures.
Read the instructions using technical terms and conduct the experiments yourself.
Understand the theoretical basis of the experiments and logically examine experimental results.
Prepare a report from the experiments.
Understand basic experimental procedures and perform specific experiments.

achievementLevels.ideal:
By the end of the course, students should be able to do the following:
- Use experimental instruments safely and accurately.
- Understand and use the analytical apparatus.
- Devise a personal experimental plan according to the experimental instructions and conduct the experiments.
- Prepare a report logically and hand in by the deadline.
achievementLevels.standard:
By the end of the course, students should be able to do the following:
- Use experimental instruments safely.
- Use the analytical apparatus.
- Conduct the experiments according to the experimental instructions.
- Prepare a report and hand in by the deadline.

              You will learn the skills related to chemistry experimental operations, instrument handling, instrumental analysis, data analysis, and report preparation.               Conduct experiments and exercises in environmental chemistry. If understanding the experiments and exercises is difficult, gain the understanding before the next class through research, questions, or other methods.
